description: Full-text search across everything licensable on Opedd (public, no key needed). Ask in plain words or use quotes for phrases and -word to exclude. Returns ranked matches with the publisher, prices, word count and a short description snippet (never the body). Use it to answer 'does Opedd have coverage on X', then lookup_content or get_content for a specific article.

publisher.description: Optional publisher slug to search within.

name: search_content
